Question ID: ENG3_U06_L05_Q01

MLA.ENG3.C.02 Context: A presentation argues that setting affects a character's values; the student can choose media showing the setting, such as a labeled image of the town square where the conflict begins. Which multimedia element best supports that purpose?\

answer.text: A decorative slide transition

feedback.text: Incorrect. A transition does not explain the setting or the character's values. Recheck the passage, context, or task wording and choose the option that preserves meaning and matches the standard.

answer.text: A labeled image of the setting with a caption tied to the claim

feedback.text: Correct. The image and caption help the audience connect setting to the presentation's claim. Notice how the answer uses the exact wording, evidence, or concept required by the standard.

answer.text: A sound effect after every bullet point

feedback.text: Incorrect. Sound effects can distract from the evidence and analysis. Recheck the passage, context, or task wording and choose the option that preserves meaning and matches the standard.

answer.text: A title font that looks old-fashioned

feedback.text: Incorrect. Font choice may affect style, but it does not give the audience useful evidence.
